text:
A vibrant vertical poster for a feel-good romantic comedy series, in the style of How I Met Your Mother key art, warm golden-hour lighting.
Center: Five attractive thirty-somethings frozen mid-laugh in a cozy New York-style bar booth, cocktails splashing, cards flying – charming playboy lead guy (30s, messy hair, winking at camera), witty female lead (30s, red dress, tossing popcorn), sarcastic best friend guy smirking, confident career-woman friend raising glass, lovable hopeless-romantic guy mid-story with wild hand gestures.
Background: Warm bar interior with string lights, neon “ON THE ROCKS” sign, scattered peanut shells, city skyline through window.
Top text in yellow retro font: “FROM THE CREATORS OF HOW I MET YOUR MOTHER”
Huge playful title in white with teal outline: “SWIPE RIGHT FOR LOVE”
Bottom tagline: “They’re thirty, flirty, and hilariously thriving.”
Fake quotes: “Pure rom-com gold!” – Entertainment Weekly
Streaming badge: “ALL EPISODES NOW STREAMING ON NETFLIX”
Bright teal-orange color grade, freeze-frame energy, sparkling bokeh, photorealistic, ultra-detailed, upbeat and nostalgic vibe.
